why: Acra-Tiin sends fish and salt across the water to the Soulrest port in small boats (Acra-Tiin record, economy).
The watch on Aphon Isle keeps a boat for its supplies, and the isle has no other way off (Aphon Belvedere record, economy).
Archon is a major seaport and the south-east's legal trade; lighters bring the bayou's rice and fish (Lore:Sea Transportation; Archon record, economy).
Arorha sends its clay and pots out by boat and takes Thorn's saltrice back (Arorha record, economy).
A great Hist crowns the mound-town, the tree the eastern villages send their eggs to (Aroxhu, Gaweja, Joxhi, Khiar and Renhu records).
The salvage station sells its finds to Lilmoth's merchants, and its island has no other way off (Bell Station record, economy).
Blackrose sits at the three-river confluence; its canoes carry the lake's commerce, and Bramman's river runs to Soulrest (Blackrose and Soulrest records; argonia-4e201-state.md, Southern water).
The raft earns its fares from travellers on the Lilmoth road (Delta Ferry record, economy).
Gideon's quay ships salt and iron out, and the city quarrels with Soulrest over who ships the bay's trade (Gideon record).
Gideon keeps Cyrodiilic habits and the western roads: the old roads of the plain run from its gate to Gul-Tej, Slough-Point and Soulrest (map, major roads; argonia-4e201-state.md, Gideon).
Gideon is the canon stop of the rootworm line, known by its red clay (Lore:Rootworm; gideon.md); the planted cutting in the Hist garden gives the worm a tree to rise at (Gideon record, faith).
Gul-Tej's river boats work the Onkobra line, whose water joins the Panther River's east to Helstrom (Gul-Tej record; argonia-4e201-state.md, the Onkobra line).
The market town on the fork keeps a caravan yard on the road to Gideon (Gul-Tej record, economy).
The rivers of the interior drain to Helstrom, and raft traffic on the Panther River fork brings it its goods (argonia-4e201-state.md; Helstrom record, economy).
Helstrom's city tree is the heart of the interior's roots: the lore has the capital reached by rootworm, and its trade is rootworm and raft traffic (argonia-4e201-state.md; Helstrom record, economy).
Inoja runs the confederacy's river ferry, where outsiders deal with the Oxhu-Teeleel (Inoja record).
A Hist stands in a pool at the town's heart, tended by a tree-minder, and the northern posts bring their hatchlings to it (Jal-Veesa and Outpost 7 records).
Jarecai guards the nearest Hist to Soulrest; every Soulrest Argonian who comes inland to hatch, name or bury pays its toll (Jarecai record).
Julo keeps the ferry across the braid below Helstrom and trades with Helstrom's outposts (Julo record, economy).
Kharaxos keeps a river market on the basin's eastern shore and trades with Jarecai (Kharaxos and Jarecai records).
Korydon builds shallow-draft boats and trades up the channels to Helstrom, Truowa and Blackrose (Korydon record, economy).
The town's tree-minder tends the tree of the channels between Helstrom and Blackrose, where eggs are laid (Korydon and Nemeon records).
Lilmoth is a major seaport whose large ships anchor out while lighter-men carry the goods in, and the market of the delta villages (Lore:Sea Transportation; Lilmoth record).
The ferry crew carries people and carts across the channel to the island core for a fare (Lujei Ferry record, economy).
Mir-Xal keeps a river quay for Blackrose-bound goods (Mir-Xal record, economy).
Noota-Nara sits on the river above Inoja and trades its pots and fish down it (map; Noota-Nara record, economy).
Nundi lives on rice, fish and its ferry across the strait to the southern island (Nundi record, economy).
Olvani's ferry carries the Aphon watch's supplies across the strait (Olvani record, economy).
Salaxul earns its landing fees from the boats along the south shore (Salaxul record, economy).
Seafalls' pilots know the shoals, and the village is the transfer point between Thorn and Archon (Seafalls record, economy).
Shalaia's rafts carry shellfish and salt out and bring rice and tools back (Shalaia record, economy).
The western road ends here at the broken bridge, and the village lives on the road trade to Gideon (map, major roads; Slough-Point record, economy).
Soulrest is a major seaport of the Southern Sea trade, with Bramman's river running inland to the Blackrose lakes (Lore:Sea Transportation; Soulrest record, economy).
Soulrest's landward gate opens on the old road north to Gideon; the two ports' rivalry runs overland as well as by sea (map, major roads; Gideon record, hooks).
Stormhold is a minor port whose river traffic is its trade; its quay is the northern end of the water that runs south to Helstrom (Lore:Sea Transportation; Stormhold record, economy).
Thorn is a minor port, the north-east's harbour for saltrice and the Tear road trade (Lore:Sea Transportation; Thorn record, economy).
Truowa holds the deep-water quay of Lake Ulaish and tolls the lake's boats; rice, fish and clay come down the lake and goods go back up (Truowa record, economy).
Tsonac sells its stone, hardwood and hides to Thorn, down its river (Tsonac record, economy).
Uluo's raft-masters move the back-water freight between Archon and the Lilmoth delta, and the elder takes a share of every raft (Uluo record, economy).
Yulca's raft ferry works the lake toward Truowa (Yulca record).
